status.description: done: the work is complete in the working tree (the wrapper commits it). blocked: a question only the engineer can answer, or a file outside the plan's folders was needed. failed: tests still red or the work could not be finished.

title.description: The commit subject for the work, conventional commit style, at most 72 characters.

files.description: Every path changed, relative to the worktree root.

tests.description: Each test file or command run and its result, one entry each.

blockers.description: What stopped the work; empty when status is done.

summary.description: What was built, in a few sentences.
